about: Legitimate uses of avoid words for tools/lint-terms.mjs (npm run lint:terms). uiOnly: words matched only in UI strings although longer than two characters. docsToo: short words matched in docs prose too. allow: {file (glob), pattern (regex: the hit must lie inside its match) or line (substring of the line), term, reason, keep? (keep even when nothing matches now)}. noPairs: term ids skipped by the ja↔en pair check (their ja word is too generic for substring pairing, e.g. 本 in 2 本 and 日本語).

m-menu marks visited cards with 「見た」; a different 印 (glossary-quality: other 印 stay).
印刷 (print), 矢印 (arrow) and 目印 are other words that contain 印.
Ordinary Open (a file, folder, window or panel). The avoid targets only the final button of New, which is 作成 / Create.
Ordinary import (audio, a ZIP file, live results). The avoid targets only the final button of Revise, which is 置き換える / Replace.
書き込み meaning a write to a file, or pen strokes on the slide, is not a comment.
知らせ meaning a notification (toast, banner, warning) is not a quality-check finding; findings are 指摘.
